# One public spelling per concept, in seven SDKs.
#
# `concept|python|ruby|php|node|elixir|java|rust`, one row per concept. A cell
# holds the public names that carry the concept in that SDK, separated by
# spaces, in the form that SDK's surface test reads:
#
#   python  a dotted path under `flezha` (`Ctx.cancel_timer`, `testing.TaskletTestHarness`),
#           `(keyword)` for a keyword the callable takes
#   ruby    a constant path, `#method` for an instance method, `.method` for a
#           singleton one, `(keyword)` for a keyword it takes
#   php     a class name, `::method` or `::$property`, `(parameter)` for a parameter
#   node    an export of the package entry, `testing/` for the testing entry,
#           `.member` for a method, a static or a field of an exported type
#   elixir  `Module.function/arity`: a public function, or a callback of the
#           behaviour `Module`; `Module.__struct__/0` for a struct type
#   java    a binary class name, `#method` for a public method of it, or
#           `package:name` for a package the authoring artifact exports to everyone
#   rust    an item path as `public-api.txt` prints it, generics left out, or
#           `#[relay(key)]` / `#[tasklet(key)]` for an attribute key
#
# A cell starting with `!` names something that must not be public: a second
# spelling this change removed, or an internal. `-` is a concept that SDK does
# not carry, with the reason in the comment above the row.
#
# Readers:
#   sdk/python/tests/test_public_names.py
#   sdk/ruby/test/public_names_test.rb
#   sdk/php/tests/PublicNamesTest.php
#   sdk/node/test/public-names.test.mjs
#   sdk/elixir/test/flezha/sdk/public_names_test.exs
#   sdk/java/flezha-sdk-testing/src/test/java/com/flezha/sdk/testing/PublicNamesTest.java
#   sdk/rust/tests/public_names.rs
